listings.name: East Bay Adventures — Mahjong Tuesday Night at Belly
listings.description: Tuesday evening mahjong at Belly Restaurant on College Avenue, run by East Bay Adventures. Complete beginners and seasoned players both welcome — a volunteer instructor, Stephen Hamano, is usually on hand to teach. Book through the restaurant's Resy page as well as RSVPing.
listings.howToJoin: Organised through the group's Meetup page.
listings.notes: Discovered 2026-08-31 via Meetup city search of Oakland and Berkeley. Teaching and the Resy booking are quoted from the event description: "Our volunteer mahjong instructor Stephen Hamano will be available for teaching on both days unless otherwise specified on Resy". The group's other night, Thursdays at 13 Orphans, is already in the directory and was skipped. CROSS-POSTED: meetup.com/walnut-creekactivefunfriends posts the same two events — same dates, same times, titled "Come Play Mahjong - Tuesday Night @ Oakland" — with no venue attached. They are one gathering advertised by two groups, so only this listing exists and the Walnut Creek postings are in this batch's excluded block. STYLE NOT STATED by the organiser — recorded as american on the base rate for US social play; confirm before relying on it.

listings.description: American Mahjong on the first Wednesday of the month in the Fellowship Hall at Bethlehem Methodist Church. Style is in the group name.
